title: Velascos no-show at NBI; lawyer confirms ex-Speaker knows Gracioso

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Speaker Lord Allan Velasco and his wife, Rowena, failed to appear before the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) to comply with the invitation letters sent to them over the “cash delivery” claims of dismissed police officer Rodulfo Gracioso Jr. Instead, the Velasco couple were only represented by their three legal counsels, who arrived at the NBI headquarters in Pasay City around 9:45 a.m. In an ambush interview, one of the counsels, Atty. Rowell Ilagan said that aside from complying with the invitation letters, they appeared at the NBI to formally request the copy of Gracioso’s affidavit implicating […]...
